about: Tiers of the AI value chain as this site classifies them. Each company has one primary tier (its main AI role, field 'tier' in companies.json and graph.json) and may sit in others ('tiers'). The classification is this site's reading of the sources behind each company's 'why included' entry, not a claim by the companies.

tiers.label: Chip builders
tiers.what_it_is: Design, make or package the chips, memory and networking that AI runs on.

tiers.label: Data centers and power
tiers.what_it_is: Own or power the buildings where AI computing runs.

tiers.label: Hyperscalers and AI clouds
tiers.what_it_is: Rent out AI computing at scale and often fund or host frontier labs.

tiers.label: Strategic investors
tiers.what_it_is: Hold large stakes in frontier labs or AI infrastructure.

tiers.label: AI deployers
tiers.what_it_is: Build AI into products that businesses, governments or consumers use.

ties.description: Multiyear partnership to deploy Nvidia CPUs, millions of Blackwell and Rubin GPUs, and Spectrum-X Ethernet switches.
Multi-year deal to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs, starting with a custom MI450-based GPU.
Broadcom delivers technology for Meta's MTIA accelerator chips through 2029; initial commitment exceeds 1 gigawatt.
Oracle Cloud to offer a public AI supercluster of 50,000 AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs from Q3 2026.
CoreWeave's 10-K says all GPUs in its infrastructure today are Nvidia GPUs.
Azure is deploying Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 racks across its Fairwater AI datacenter sites.
AWS and Nvidia plan to deploy 2 million additional Nvidia GPUs across AWS infrastructure.
Google Cloud A5X instances run on Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72, scaling to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs.
OCI Zettascale10 clusters connect hundreds of thousands of Nvidia GPUs, initially up to 800,000.
Nebius, an Nvidia Cloud Partner, will deploy Vera Rubin NVL72 in US and European data centers from H2 2026.
SoftBank Corp., a SoftBank Group unit, deployed a DGX SuperPOD with over 4,000 Nvidia Blackwell GPUs.
Microsoft is bringing AMD's Helios AI platform and EPYC CPUs to Azure, including ND MI455X v7 VMs.
IBM Cloud offers AMD EPYC CPUs and Instinct GPUs for AI training and inference.
G42's large-scale AI cluster in the UAE features AMD MI350X GPUs, per Cisco's release.
Cisco will power, connect and secure a large G42 AI cluster with its networking, compute and security stack.
Long-term agreement for Broadcom to develop and supply Google's future custom TPUs and AI rack components through 2031.
Broadcom's Fort Collins, Colorado facility produces radio frequency components for a wide range of Apple products.
Nvidia's 10-K names SK hynix as one of its memory suppliers.
Nvidia's 10-K names Samsung as one of its memory suppliers.
Microsoft's Cobalt 200 CPUs are Arm-based custom silicon running across Azure data centers.
AWS Graviton CPUs, including Graviton5, are Arm-based custom silicon.
Nvidia's 10-K says it uses foundries such as TSMC to produce its semiconductor wafers.
Nvidia's 10-K names Samsung, with TSMC, among the foundries producing its wafers.
AMD relies on TSMC for all wafers for its microprocessor and GPU products at 7nm or smaller.
About 95% of wafers made by Broadcom's contract manufacturers in fiscal 2025 were produced by TSMC.
TSMC's Arizona fab is producing more than 100 million chips for Apple products in 2026.
Tesla's 10-K cites a new collaboration with Samsung to make advanced AI inference and training chips in the US.
Oracle is Digital Realty's second-largest customer, 9.0% of annualized recurring revenue across 42 locations.
IBM is Digital Realty's fifth-largest customer, 2.3% of annualized recurring revenue across 34 locations.
Meta Platforms is Digital Realty's eighth-largest customer, 1.6% of annualized recurring revenue across 49 locations.
LinkedIn, a Microsoft subsidiary, is Digital Realty's seventh-largest customer by annualized recurring revenue.
Georgia regulators' staff approved Georgia Power's contract to serve a planned OpenAI data center near Savannah.
Expanded long-term agreement for dedicated AI cloud capacity across multiple sites through December 2032, about $21 billion.
Microsoft was CoreWeave's top customer, about 67% of its 2025 revenue.
Multi-year agreement to deliver dedicated AI capacity to Microsoft from Nebius's Vineland, New Jersey data center.
Five-year deal to provide $12 billion of dedicated capacity on Nvidia Vera Rubin from early 2027.
Apple integrated ChatGPT access into Siri and system features in iOS 18, iPadOS 18 and macOS Sequoia.
Next-generation Apple Foundation Models, powering a more personalized Siri, will be based on Google's Gemini models.
Claudeforce partnership: Claude is available in Agentforce and is the default model for Slack AI and Slackbot.
Customers can use OpenAI frontier models, including GPT-5, to build agents and prompts on the Salesforce Platform.
Claude is the default model powering ServiceNow Build Agent and is integrated into core ServiceNow workflows.
Enhanced collaboration gives ServiceNow customers direct access to OpenAI frontier models, including GPT-5.2.
OCI Generative AI offers Meta Llama 4 Maverick, Llama 4 Scout and Llama 3.3 chat models.
Alibaba Cloud Model Studio lets customers call DeepSeek series models, including DeepSeek V4 versions.
